  - {code: "CAT-200-VARIANTS-IN-USE", rule: RULE-CAT-010, api: [API-CAT-051], http: 200, trigger: "turn-off check of `variants` while active assignments exist on active Variants of active Items (allowed = false; {count})", messages: {ar: "لا يمكن إيقاف المتغيّرات لأن {count} صنفًا يستخدمها. أوقف متغيّرات هذه الأصناف أو أبقِ المتغيّرات مفعّلة.", en: "Variants cannot be turned off because {count} items use them. Deactivate the variants of these items or keep variants on."}}
  - {code: "CAT-200-BUNDLES-IN-USE", rule: RULE-CAT-011, api: [API-CAT-051], http: 200, trigger: "turn-off check of `bundles` while active BUNDLE Items exist (allowed = false; {count})", messages: {ar: "لا يمكن إيقاف الحزم لوجود {count} حزمة نشطة. أوقف هذه الحزم أو أبقِ الحزم مفعّلة.", en: "Bundles cannot be turned off because {count} active bundles exist. Deactivate these bundles or keep bundles on."}}
  - {code: "CAT-201-EXISTING-VARIANTS-KEPT", rule: RULE-CAT-012, api: [API-CAT-006], http: 201, trigger: "success notice: existing Variants took the first selected values and kept their codes and barcodes", messages: {ar: "احتفظت المتغيّرات الحالية بأرقامها وباركوداتها وأُسندت إليها القيم الأولى المختارة.", en: "Existing variants kept their codes and barcodes and took the first selected values."}}
  - {code: "CAT-409-VARIANT-COMBINATION-DUPLICATE", rule: RULE-CAT-013, api: [API-CAT-006], http: 409, trigger: "the requested combination is already carried by another active Variant of the Item", messages: {ar: "هذه التركيبة من القيم موجودة في متغيّر آخر لهذا الصنف.", en: "This combination of values already exists on another variant of this item."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-VARIANT-LIMIT-EXCEEDED", rule: RULE-CAT-014, api: [API-CAT-006], http: 422, trigger: "generation would give the Item more than 3 attributes or 300 active Variants", messages: {ar: "الحد الأقصى 3 خصائص و300 متغيّر نشط للصنف الواحد.", en: "An item can have at most 3 attributes and 300 active variants."}}
  - {code: "CAT-409-LAST-ACTIVE-VARIANT", rule: RULE-CAT-015, api: [API-CAT-009], http: 409, trigger: "deactivating the last active Variant of an active Item", messages: {ar: "لا يمكن إيقاف آخر متغيّر نشط لصنف نشط. أوقف الصنف نفسه بدلًا من ذلك.", en: "The last active variant of an active item cannot be deactivated. Deactivate the item instead."}}
  - {code: "CAT-409-ATTRIBUTE-CODE-NAME-DUPLICATE", rule: RULE-CAT-016, api: [API-CAT-025, API-CAT-027, API-CAT-029, API-CAT-030], http: 409, trigger: "attribute / value code taken in its scope, nameAr taken among active records, or code not 1–30 Latin letters, digits or hyphens", messages: {ar: "الرمز أو الاسم مستخدم بالفعل. استخدم رمزًا (حتى 30 حرفًا لاتينيًا أو رقمًا أو شرطة) واسمًا مختلفين.", en: "The code or name is already used. Use a different code (up to 30 Latin letters, digits or hyphens) and name."}}
  - {code: "CAT-409-ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-IN-USE", rule: RULE-CAT-017, api: [API-CAT-028, API-CAT-031], http: 409, trigger: "deactivating an attribute or value that an active assignment of an active Variant carries ({count})", messages: {ar: "هذه الخاصية أو القيمة مستخدمة في {count} متغيّرًا نشطًا. أوقف هذه المتغيّرات أولًا.", en: "This attribute or value is used by {count} active variants. Deactivate those variants first."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-BUNDLE-COMPONENTS-REQUIRED", rule: RULE-CAT-018, api: [API-CAT-001, API-CAT-017], http: 422, trigger: "a BUNDLE saved with no active line, or a quantity not above zero / with more than 3 decimals", messages: {ar: "أضف مكوّنًا واحدًا على الأقل بكمية أكبر من صفر (حتى 3 أرقام عشرية).", en: "Add at least one component with a quantity above zero (up to 3 decimals)."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-BUNDLE-COMPONENT-INVALID", rule: RULE-CAT-019, api: [API-CAT-001, API-CAT-017], http: 422, trigger: "a component Variant is inactive, belongs to a BUNDLE Item, or is listed twice", messages: {ar: "المكوّن يجب أن يكون متغيّرًا نشطًا لصنف ليس حزمة، ولا يتكرر في الحزمة نفسها.", en: "A component must be an active variant of an item that is not a bundle, listed once per bundle."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-BUNDLE-SINGLE-VARIANT", rule: RULE-CAT-020, api: [API-CAT-006], http: 422, trigger: "Variant generation or attribute assignment for an Item of kind BUNDLE", messages: {ar: "الحزمة لها متغيّر واحد فقط ولا تقبل خصائص المتغيّرات.", en: "A bundle has one variant only and takes no variant attributes."}}
  - {code: "CAT-409-VARIANT-IN-ACTIVE-BUNDLE", rule: RULE-CAT-021, api: [API-CAT-004, API-CAT-009], http: 409, trigger: "deactivating a Variant, or its Item, while it is an active component of an active Bundle ({count})", messages: {ar: "هذا المتغيّر مكوّن في {count} حزمة نشطة. أزله من هذه الحزم أو أوقفها أولًا.", en: "This variant is a component of {count} active bundles. Remove it from those bundles or deactivate them first."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-ITEM-KIND-FIXED", rule: RULE-CAT-022, api: [API-CAT-003], http: 422, trigger: "an update changes itemKindCode of a saved Item", messages: {ar: "لا يمكن تغيير نوع الصنف بعد حفظه. أنشئ صنفًا جديدًا بالنوع المطلوب.", en: "The item kind cannot be changed after saving. Create a new item of the required kind."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-CATEGORY-PARENT-INVALID", rule: RULE-CAT-023, api: [API-CAT-021, API-CAT-023], http: 422, trigger: "parent inactive, the Category itself or one of its sub-categories, or depth above 5", messages: {ar: "الفئة الأم يجب أن تكون نشطة، وألا تكون الفئة نفسها أو إحدى فئاتها الفرعية، وألا يتجاوز العمق 5 مستويات.", en: "The parent category must be active, must not be the category itself or one of its sub-categories, and the depth cannot exceed 5 levels."}}
  - {code: "CAT-409-CATEGORY-DUPLICATE", rule: RULE-CAT-024, api: [API-CAT-021, API-CAT-023], http: 409, trigger: "Category code taken, nameAr taken among active siblings, or code not 1–30 Latin letters, digits or hyphens", messages: {ar: "يوجد رمز الفئة نفسه، أو الاسم نفسه تحت الفئة الأم نفسها. استخدم رمزًا أو اسمًا مختلفًا.", en: "The category code already exists, or the name already exists under the same parent. Use a different code or name."}}
  - {code: "CAT-409-CATEGORY-IN-USE", rule: RULE-CAT-025, api: [API-CAT-024], http: 409, trigger: "deactivating a Category with active sub-categories or active Items ({count})", messages: {ar: "لا يمكن إيقاف الفئة لوجود {count} فئة فرعية أو صنف نشط فيها. انقلها أو أوقفها أولًا.", en: "The category cannot be deactivated while it holds {count} active sub-categories or items. Move or deactivate them first."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-CATEGORY-INACTIVE", rule: RULE-CAT-026, api: [API-CAT-001, API-CAT-003], http: 422, trigger: "a changed categoryFk points to an inactive Category", messages: {ar: "الفئة المختارة غير نشطة. اختر فئة نشطة.", en: "The selected category is inactive. Choose an active category."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-ITEM-UNIT-INVALID", rule: RULE-CAT-027, api: [API-CAT-010], http: 422, trigger: "unit equals the base unit or another active unit of the Item, or factor not above zero / more than 6 decimals", messages: {ar: "الوحدة يجب أن تختلف عن الوحدة الأساسية وألا تتكرر، ومعامل التحويل أكبر من صفر (حتى 6 أرقام عشرية).", en: "The unit must differ from the base unit and appear once, with a conversion factor above zero (up to 6 decimals)."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-CONVERSION-FACTOR-FIXED", rule: RULE-CAT-028, api: [API-CAT-012], http: 422, trigger: "an update changes conversionFactor of a saved Item unit", messages: {ar: "لا يمكن تعديل معامل التحويل بعد الحفظ. أوقف هذه الوحدة وأضفها من جديد بالمعامل الصحيح.", en: "The conversion factor cannot be changed after saving. Deactivate this unit and add it again with the correct factor."}}
  - {code: "CAT-409-BARCODE-DUPLICATE", rule: RULE-CAT-029, api: [API-CAT-014, API-CAT-015], http: 409, trigger: "barcodeValue equals an active barcode of the tenant ({code} = owning Item code)", messages: {ar: "هذا الباركود مستخدم في الصنف {code}. افتح ذلك الصنف أو استخدم باركودًا آخر.", en: "This barcode is already used by item {code}. Open that item or use another barcode."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-GTIN-INVALID", rule: RULE-CAT-030, api: [API-CAT-014], http: 422, trigger: "GTIN not 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, or wrong GS1 check digit", messages: {ar: "باركود GTIN يجب أن يتكون من 8 أو 12 أو 13 أو 14 رقمًا برقم تحقق صحيح.", en: "A GTIN barcode must have 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits with a valid check digit."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-BARCODE-UNIT-INVALID", rule: RULE-CAT-031, api: [API-CAT-014, API-CAT-015], http: 422, trigger: "barcode unit is neither the Item's base unit nor an active Item unit", messages: {ar: "وحدة الباركود يجب أن تكون الوحدة الأساسية للصنف أو إحدى وحداته النشطة.", en: "The barcode unit must be the item's base unit or one of its active units."}}
  - {code: "CAT-409-BARCODE-SCALE-PREFIX", rule: RULE-CAT-032, api: [API-CAT-014, API-CAT-015, API-CAT-032], http: 409, trigger: "a GTIN / INTERNAL barcode begins with an active layout key, or a new layout key begins an active GTIN / INTERNAL barcode ({prefix})", messages: {ar: "الباركود يبدأ ببادئة ملصق ميزان نشط ({prefix}). استخدم باركودًا آخر أو عدّل إعداد الميزان.", en: "The barcode starts with the prefix of an active scale label layout ({prefix}). Use another barcode or change the scale settings."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-SCALE-CODE-LENGTH", rule: RULE-CAT-033, api: [API-CAT-014], http: 422, trigger: "SCALE barcode not all digits, of a length no active layout uses, or no active layout exists ({length})", messages: {ar: "رمز الميزان يجب أن يتكون من {length} أرقام، ويلزم وجود إعداد ملصق ميزان نشط.", en: "The scale code must have {length} digits, and an active scale label layout is required."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-SCALE-LAYOUT-INVALID", rule: RULE-CAT-034, api: [API-CAT-032, API-CAT-033], http: 422, trigger: "prefix outside 02 / 20–29 or used by another active layout, scaleCodeLength outside 4–6, valueDecimals outside 0–3", messages: {ar: "البادئة رقمان (02 أو من 20 إلى 29) غير مستخدمة في إعداد نشط آخر، وطول رمز الميزان من 4 إلى 6، والأرقام العشرية من 0 إلى 3.", en: "The prefix is two digits (02 or 20 to 29) not used by another active layout, the scale code length is 4 to 6, and the decimals are 0 to 3."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-SCALE-LABEL-UNREADABLE", rule: RULE-CAT-035, api: [API-CAT-043], http: 422, trigger: "a value with an active layout prefix has a wrong check digit or an unknown scale code", messages: {ar: "تعذّر قراءة ملصق الميزان: رقم التحقق غير صحيح أو رمز الميزان غير معرَّف. اطلب الصنف بالاسم أو أضف رمز الميزان إليه.", en: "The scale label could not be read: the check digit is wrong or the scale code is not defined. Find the item by name or add the scale code to it."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-LABEL-COPIES-OUT-OF-RANGE", rule: RULE-CAT-036, api: [API-CAT-050], http: 422, trigger: "fewer than 1 or more than 999 copies of a Variant, or more than 5,000 labels", messages: {ar: "عدد النسخ لكل متغيّر من 1 إلى 999، وإجمالي الملصقات لا يتجاوز 5000.", en: "Copies per variant are 1 to 999, and the total cannot exceed 5,000 labels."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-LABEL-VARIANT-NO-BARCODE", rule: RULE-CAT-037, api: [API-CAT-050], http: 422, trigger: "a label request lists Variants without an active barcode ({count}; the Variants are listed)", messages: {ar: "لا يوجد باركود نشط لـ {count} متغيّر. أنشئ لها باركودًا داخليًا ثم اطبع.", en: "{count} variants have no active barcode. Generate an internal barcode for them, then print."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-IMAGE-NOT-ACCEPTED", rule: RULE-CAT-038, api: [API-CAT-018], http: 422, trigger: "image not JPG / PNG / WEBP, above 5 MB, or a 21st active image", messages: {ar: "الصورة يجب أن تكون JPG أو PNG أو WEBP بحجم لا يتجاوز 5 ميجابايت، وبحد أقصى 20 صورة نشطة للصنف.", en: "The image must be JPG, PNG or WEBP of at most 5 MB, with at most 20 active images per item."}}
  - {code: "CAT-200-PRIMARY-IMAGE-REPLACED", rule: RULE-CAT-039, api: [API-CAT-019], http: 200, trigger: "success notice: the selected image became the main image in place of the former one", messages: {ar: "للصنف صورة رئيسية واحدة فقط؛ تم تعيين الصورة المختارة رئيسية بدل السابقة.", en: "An item has exactly one main image; the selected image replaced the previous main image."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-MEDIA-VARIANT-MISMATCH", rule: RULE-CAT-040, api: [API-CAT-018, API-CAT-019], http: 422, trigger: "variantFk of a media record belongs to another Item", messages: {ar: "المتغيّر المختار لا ينتمي إلى هذا الصنف.", en: "The selected variant does not belong to this item."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-PUBLISH-BLOCKED", rule: RULE-CAT-041, api: [API-CAT-005], http: 422, trigger: "publishing an inactive Item or an Item with no active Variant", messages: {ar: "لا يمكن نشر صنف غير نشط أو بلا متغيّر نشط. فعّل الصنف أو أحد متغيّراته أولًا.", en: "An inactive item, or one with no active variant, cannot be published. Activate the item or one of its variants first."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-EINVOICE-CODE-INVALID", rule: RULE-CAT-042, api: [API-CAT-001, API-CAT-003, API-CAT-008], http: 422, trigger: "only one of type and code, a GS1 code not 8–14 digits, or an EGS code not starting with EG- / above 100 characters", messages: {ar: "أدخل نوع رمز الفاتورة الإلكترونية والرمز معًا: GS1 من 8 إلى 14 رقمًا، وEGS يبدأ بـ EG- ولا يتجاوز 100 حرف.", en: "Enter the e-invoice code type and code together: GS1 is 8 to 14 digits, EGS starts with EG- and has at most 100 characters."}}
  - {code: "CAT-409-UNIT-EINVOICE-DUPLICATE", rule: RULE-CAT-043, api: [API-CAT-035], http: 409, trigger: "a Unit e-invoice code is created for a unit that already has an active one", messages: {ar: "لهذه الوحدة رمز فاتورة إلكترونية نشط بالفعل. عدّله بدلًا من إضافة رمز جديد.", en: "This unit already has an active e-invoice unit. Change it instead of adding a new one."}}
  - {code: "CAT-422-IMPORT-FILE-REJECTED", rule: RULE-CAT-044, api: [API-CAT-049], http: 422, trigger: "import file not xlsx, above 10 MB, above 5,000 data rows, or with a different header row; no Item is created", messages: {ar: "الملف غير مقبول: يجب أن يكون بصيغة xlsx بحجم لا يتجاوز 10 ميجابايت وحتى 5000 صف، وبعناوين ورقة الاستيراد نفسها. نزّل ورقة الاستيراد واستخدمها.", en: "The file was not accepted: it must be xlsx, at most 10 MB and 5,000 rows, with the import sheet headers. Download the import sheet and use it."}}
  - {code: "CAT-200-IMPORT-ROW-REJECTED", rule: RULE-CAT-045, api: [API-CAT-049], http: 200, trigger: "per rejected row inside a completed import result ({row}, {column}, {reason} = the failed rule's message)", messages: {ar: "الصف {row}، العمود {column}: {reason}. صحّح الصف وأعد استيراده.", en: "Row {row}, column {column}: {reason}. Correct the row and import it again."}}
  - {code: "CAT-400-SEARCH-TERM-TOO-SHORT", rule: RULE-CAT-046, api: [API-CAT-047], http: 400, trigger: "catalogue search term shorter than 2 characters; no results", messages: {ar: "اكتب حرفين على الأقل للبحث.", en: "Type at least 2 characters to search."}}
  - {code: "CAT-404-BARCODE-NOT-FOUND", rule: RULE-CAT-047, api: [API-CAT-043], http: 404, trigger: "no active barcode and no active scale label layout matches the looked-up value", messages: {ar: "لا يوجد صنف بهذا الباركود. ابحث بالاسم أو أضف الباركود إلى الصنف.", en: "No item has this barcode. Search by name or add the barcode to the item."}}
  - {code: "CAT-200-DEACTIVATED", rule: RULE-CAT-048, api: [API-CAT-004, API-CAT-009, API-CAT-013, API-CAT-016, API-CAT-024], http: 200, trigger: "success notice after a soft deactivation of a SHARED record", messages: {ar: "تم الإيقاف. يبقى السجل متاحًا للمستندات السابقة ولا يظهر في الاختيارات الجديدة.", en: "Deactivated. The record stays available to earlier documents and no longer appears in new selections."}}
  - {code: "CAT-500-CHANGE-NOT-SAVED", rule: RULE-CAT-049, api: [API-CAT-001, API-CAT-003, API-CAT-004, API-CAT-005, API-CAT-006, API-CAT-008, API-CAT-009, API-CAT-010, API-CAT-012, API-CAT-013, API-CAT-014, API-CAT-015, API-CAT-016, API-CAT-017, API-CAT-018, API-CAT-019, API-CAT-020, API-CAT-049], http: 500, trigger: "the commit of a catalogue change fails and the transaction rolls back; no event is delivered", messages: {ar: "تعذّر حفظ التغيير ولم يُرسل أي إشعار بالتغيير. أعد المحاولة.", en: "The change was not saved and no change notice was sent.   - {code: "CAT-403-FORBIDDEN", rule: PLATFORM-STD, api: [API-CAT-001, API-CAT-002, API-CAT-003, API-CAT-004, API-CAT-005, API-CAT-006, API-CAT-007, API-CAT-008, API-CAT-009, API-CAT-010, API-CAT-011, API-CAT-012, API-CAT-013, API-CAT-014, API-CAT-015, API-CAT-016, API-CAT-017, API-CAT-018, API-CAT-019, API-CAT-020, API-CAT-021, API-CAT-022, API-CAT-023, API-CAT-024, API-CAT-025, API-CAT-026, API-CAT-027, API-CAT-028, API-CAT-029, API-CAT-030, API-CAT-031, API-CAT-032, API-CAT-033, API-CAT-034, API-CAT-035, API-CAT-036, API-CAT-037, API-CAT-038, API-CAT-039, API-CAT-040, API-CAT-041, API-CAT-042, API-CAT-043, API-CAT-044, API-CAT-045, API-CAT-046, API-CAT-048, API-CAT-049, API-CAT-050, API-CAT-051], http: 403, trigger: "the caller lacks the endpoint's PERM_<PAGE_CODE>_<ACTION>", adr: "ADR-CAT-044"}
  - {code: "CAT-404-NOT-FOUND", rule: PLATFORM-STD, api: [API-CAT-001, API-CAT-002, API-CAT-003, API-CAT-004, API-CAT-005, API-CAT-006, API-CAT-007, API-CAT-008, API-CAT-009, API-CAT-010, API-CAT-011, API-CAT-012, API-CAT-013, API-CAT-014, API-CAT-015, API-CAT-016, API-CAT-017, API-CAT-018, API-CAT-019, API-CAT-020, API-CAT-021, API-CAT-022, API-CAT-023, API-CAT-024, API-CAT-026, API-CAT-027, API-CAT-028, API-CAT-029, API-CAT-030, API-CAT-031, API-CAT-033, API-CAT-034, API-CAT-036, API-CAT-037, API-CAT-040, API-CAT-044, API-CAT-050], http: 404, trigger: "an identifier names no record of the caller's tenant", adr: "ADR-CAT-044"}

## 3.0 Binding to the API document

Reconciliation against the SRS (run once, before any phase):
- **REQ → operation**: 126 of 127 REQs bind to at least one operation that a CAT screen calls (block below). REQ-CAT-115 (storefront read) is served by `API-CAT-046`, which no CAT screen calls; SFR consumes it (ADR-CAT-051). No REQ needs an operation the document lacks. Lookup values (REQ-CAT-073, 074, 076) and capability flags (REQ-CAT-011 … 015) are served by the given and bound through UXD-CAT-001 / 002 (ADR-CAT-050).
- **Operation → REQ**: every one of the 51 operations carries `x-traces` to at least one REQ, so no operation is unknown. Two operations (`API-CAT-011`, `API-CAT-046`) are not called by a CAT screen (ADR-CAT-051).
- **Envelope**: success bodies are `ApiResponse<T>` (`data`, `code`, `messageAr`, `messageEn`). Errors are `LocalizedError` (`code`, `messageAr`, `messageEn`). Paged reads (`x-paginated`) take `page` / `size`. Two binary bodies exist: the import sheet (xlsx, `API-CAT-048`) and the label document (PDF, `API-CAT-050`).
- **Platform-standard codes** (ADR-CAT-044) map to no RULE and are routed generically: `CAT-400-REQUEST-INVALID` → generic message · `CAT-401-UNAUTHENTICATED` → login · `CAT-403-FORBIDDEN` → unauthorized view (or a hidden affordance for an auxiliary read — ADR-CAT-051 §4) · `CAT-404-NOT-FOUND` → not-found state · `CAT-409-STALE-VERSION` → stale-version banner with Reload · `CAT-413-PAYLOAD-TOO-LARGE` / `CAT-415-UNSUPPORTED-MEDIA-TYPE` → inline on the file input · `CAT-500-SERVER-ERROR` → generic message with Try again. In every case the text is the envelope's `messageAr` / `messageEn`.

## F1 — Models & Types

Field and DTO binding: the request and response schemas of this module's operations in `api-spec-cat.yaml` are the source. The blocks below name which schema each screen binds, by operation, and add only the UI-side types that exist in neither the document nor the SRS (form state, pending lines, URL filter objects). TypeScript types are generated from the document (one generator run, no hand-written DTO). Every UI type below is a projection of a generated type.

Shared across screens:
- `ApiResponse<T>` and `Page<T>` (`content`, `page`, `size`, `totalElements`, `totalPages`) wrap every read. `LocalizedError` is the error body.
- `LookupOption = { code, labelAr, labelEn, isActive }` is the UI shape of a given lookup value (UXD-CAT-001). `CapabilityFlags = { variants: boolean | unknown, bundles: boolean | unknown }` is the UI shape of the given flags (UXD-CAT-002). `unknown` means unreadable (REQ-CAT-013).
- `PendingState = 'new' | 'changed' | 'deactivate' | 'failed'` marks a child line not yet sent (ADR-CAT-049). It is UI-only and never sent.

### F1 · SCR-CAT-001 — Items

Bound schemas: search `ItemSummary` page (API-CAT-038) · read `ItemDetail` with `VariantSummary`, `AttributeValueView`, `BarcodeView`, `ItemUnitView`, `BundleComponentView`, `MediaView` (API-CAT-002) · `VariantDetail` (API-CAT-007) · create `ItemCreateRequest` (API-CAT-001) · update `ItemUpdateRequest` (API-CAT-003) · state `ItemStateRequest` (API-CAT-005) · deactivate response `ItemSummary` (API-CAT-004) · `VariantGenerationRequest` → `VariantGenerationResult` (API-CAT-006) · `VariantOverrideRequest` (API-CAT-008) · `ItemUnitCreateRequest` / `ItemUnitUpdateRequest` (API-CAT-010 / 012) · `BarcodeCreateRequest` / `InternalBarcodeRequest` (API-CAT-014 / 015) · `BundleComponentsRequest` (API-CAT-017) · `ItemMediaUpload` multipart / `ItemMediaUpdateRequest` (API-CAT-018 / 019) · Variant, unit, barcode and media deactivations (API-CAT-009, 013, 016, 020) · `CategoryNode` (API-CAT-039) · `VariantAttributeView` (API-CAT-041) · `BarcodeLookupResult` (API-CAT-043) · `MediaView` list (API-CAT-044) · `CatalogueSettings` (API-CAT-045) · `CatalogueSearchHit` (API-CAT-047).

UI types:
- `ItemSearchFilters = { text?, categoryFk?, brandCode?, itemKindCode?, publishStateCode?, isActiveFl?, page, size }`. It is the URL search params of `/cat/items`, parsed and defaulted (`isActiveFl: true`, `page: 0`, `size: 20`). `itemKindCode` is dropped while `bundles` is off.
- `ItemForm`. Header: the `ItemUpdateRequest` properties the user edits (`nameAr`, `nameEn`, `categoryFk`, `brandCode`, `taxClassCode`, `einvoiceCodeTypeCode`, `einvoiceCode`, `descriptionAr`, `descriptionEn`), plus `itemKindCode` and `baseUomCode` on create only, plus `version` on update. Collections: `bundleLines[]` (`bundleComponentPk?`, `componentVariantFk`, `quantity`, `sortOrder`); `units[]` (`ItemUnitView` + `pending`); `barcodes[]` (`BarcodeView` + `pending`, or a new `{ variantFk, barcodeTypeCode, barcodeValue?, uomCode, internal: boolean }`); `variantOverrides[]` (`variantPk`, `einvoiceCodeTypeCode`, `einvoiceCode`, `version`); `variantDeactivations[]` (`variantPk`); `generation?` (`selections[]` as in `VariantGenerationRequest`); `media[]` (`MediaView` + `pending`, or a new `{ file: File, nameAr, nameEn?, variantFk? }`).
- Never sent (ADR-CAT-051 §6): `code` on any request; `itemKindCode` / `baseUomCode` on update; `conversionFactor` on Item unit update. `bundleComponents: []` is sent on create of a STANDARD Item, because the document marks it required.
- `ItemRouteState = { itemPk | 'new', variant?, drawer?: '<line-kind>:<id|new>', picker?: 'variant-generation' | 'bundle-components' }`, parsed from the route and its search params.
<!-- SUB:F1-SCR-CAT-001:END -->

## F2 — Data Hooks

These blocks declare what each screen reads and changes, not hook code. Rules shared by every screen:
- **Hook layering**: components use the screen facade only, and the facade uses only the queries declared here (server-state library `tanstack-query`).
- **Cache keys**: page and page size live inside the filter object that forms the cache key. Every filter that changes the response is in the key. The filter object is the route's search params, so back/forward restores a list.
- **Navigation state**: the router holds every open drawer and second level. No `zustand` store holds server data or open state; `zustand` is used by CAT only for the per-user list page size preference.
- **Cache policy**: defaults (staleTime 0, gcTime 5 min, refetch on focus), with three deviations recorded in ADR-CAT-050 / 051:
  - lookups (UXD-CAT-001): staleTime 30 min, gcTime 60 min;
  - the Category tree used as options: staleTime 5 min;
  - capability flags (UXD-CAT-002): staleTime 0, refetched on every screen entry and window focus (REQ-CAT-012).
- **Error routing**: every server code routed to a control names its text by reference: the RULE message (SRS) in ar and en, as the envelope carries it. Platform codes route as §3.0 states.
- **Loading**: LOCAL everywhere (skeleton or button progress). No call is declared slow by the SRS, so no GLOBAL loading.

Lookups shared by all screens (one hook per key, the given's lookup client, UXD-CAT-001; options are the active values with code and ar/en labels; a value already on a record keeps its label even when inactive):
`CAT_BRAND-LOOKUP` · `CAT_UOM-LOOKUP` · `CAT_TAX_CLASS-LOOKUP` · `CAT_ITEM_KIND-LOOKUP` · `CAT_PUBLISH_STATE-LOOKUP` · `CAT_EINVOICE_ITEM_CODE_TYPE-LOOKUP` · `CAT_BARCODE_TYPE-LOOKUP` · `CAT_SCALE_VALUE_TYPE-LOOKUP` · `CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT-LOOKUP`. Each has cache key `[mdl, lookup, <KEY>]`. On error the field shows the raw code and the select is disabled, with the generic message.

`CAPABILITY-FLAGS-INIT` (UXD-CAT-002): reads `variants` and `bundles` through the platform app configuration, with cache key `[platform, app-config]`. An unreadable value is `unknown` and is treated as off for display, with RULE-CAT-009's text shown where the function would be.

hooks:

  - {hook: ITEM-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-002], cache_key: "[cat, items, detail, itemPk]", errors: "CAT-404-NOT-FOUND → not-found state with Back to search · CAT-401 → login · CAT-403 → unauthorized · CAT-500 → generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: CATEGORY-OPTIONS-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-039], cache_key: "[cat, categories, tree, {isActiveFl: true}]", errors: "CAT-403-FORBIDDEN → Category field and filter hidden, column shows the code (ADR-CAT-051) · other → generic", loading: NONE, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: ATTRIBUTE-OPTIONS-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-041], cache_key: "[cat, variant-attributes, list, {isActiveFl: true}]", errors: "CAT-422-CAPABILITY-OFF → picker shows RULE-CAT-008 text · CAT-500-CAPABILITY-UNREADABLE → RULE-CAT-009 text · CAT-403-FORBIDDEN → Generate variants hidden", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: COMPONENT-PICKER-ITEMS-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-038], cache_key: "[cat, items, search, {text, itemKindCode: STANDARD, isActiveFl: true, page, size}]", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: COMPONENT-PICKER-VARIANTS-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-002], cache_key: "[cat, items, detail, itemPk]", errors: "CAT-404-NOT-FOUND → Item row disabled · other → generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: COMPONENT-VARIANT-LABEL-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-007], cache_key: "[cat, variants, detail, variantPk]", errors: "CAT-404-NOT-FOUND → line shows componentVariantCode only · other → code only", loading: NONE, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: SCALE-AVAILABILITY-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-045], cache_key: "[cat, settings]", errors: "CAT-403-FORBIDDEN → SCALE type not offered (ADR-CAT-051) · other → SCALE not offered", loading: NONE, invalidation: "—"}

  - {hook: CAT_BRAND-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, cache_key: "[mdl, lookup, CAT_BRAND]", errors: "select disabled, generic", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: CAT_UOM-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, cache_key: "[mdl, lookup, CAT_UOM]", errors: "select disabled, generic", loading: NONE}

#### ITEM-SEARCH-QUERY — API-CAT-038            traces=API-CAT-038,REQ-CAT-003,REQ-CAT-014,REQ-CAT-015
Read query. The filter object is the URL search params. `itemKindCode` is never sent while `bundles` is off (REQ-CAT-015). Results are sorted by nameAr on the server. The Category column is labelled from CATEGORY-OPTIONS-QUERY (`categoryFk` → node nameAr); the brand, kind and publish columns are labelled from their lookups.

#### ITEM-QUERY — API-CAT-002            traces=API-CAT-002,REQ-CAT-001,REQ-CAT-002,REQ-CAT-010,REQ-CAT-029,REQ-CAT-058,REQ-CAT-119
Read query, enabled when `itemPk` is a number. It feeds the header, every pane, the Barcode unit options (`baseUomCode` + active `itemUnits[].uomCode` — RULE-CAT-031), the image Variant options (`variants[]`), and the version tokens of the Item, Variants, units and media. It is re-read after every Save, so the committed state is what is shown (REQ-CAT-010).

#### CATEGORY-OPTIONS-QUERY — API-CAT-039            traces=API-CAT-039,REQ-CAT-072
Read query feeding the Category tree select (active nodes only) and labelling `categoryFk` in the list and the header. The control that chooses a Category and the label of the rendered `categoryFk` both come from this read.

#### ATTRIBUTE-OPTIONS-QUERY — API-CAT-041            traces=API-CAT-041,REQ-CAT-014,REQ-CAT-044,REQ-CAT-047,REQ-CAT-049
Read query feeding the Variant generation picker: active attributes with their active values, by sortOrder. Enabled only while `variants` is on and the picker is open. Inactive attributes and values are not offered (REQ-CAT-044, REQ-CAT-047).

#### COMPONENT-PICKER-ITEMS-QUERY / COMPONENT-PICKER-VARIANTS-QUERY — API-CAT-038, API-CAT-002            traces=API-CAT-038,API-CAT-002,REQ-CAT-020,REQ-CAT-060
The Bundle component picker searches active STANDARD Items. Expanding an Item reads it and offers its active Variants (`variants[]` with `isActiveFl`). A Variant already in `bundleLines` is disabled (RULE-CAT-019). Both stay inside PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW (ADR-CAT-051 §3).

#### COMPONENT-VARIANT-LABEL-QUERY — API-CAT-007            traces=API-CAT-007,REQ-CAT-058
Labels each Bundle component line: `BundleComponentView` carries `componentVariantFk` and `componentVariantCode`, and this read adds the Variant nameAr / nameEn. One read per distinct `componentVariantFk`, cached by `variantPk`.

#### SCALE-AVAILABILITY-QUERY — API-CAT-045            traces=API-CAT-045,REQ-CAT-096
Offers barcode type SCALE in the barcode drawer only while at least one `scaleLabelLayouts[]` entry has `isActiveFl` true. The drawer also shows the expected length, from the active layouts' `scaleCodeLength` (RULE-CAT-033). It shares its key with SCR-CAT-006, so a layout saved there refreshes this read.

#### VARIANT-IMAGES-QUERY — API-CAT-044            traces=API-CAT-044,REQ-CAT-109
Read on expanding a Variant row: the images bound to that Variant, or the Item's unbound images, primary first. Thumbnails come through IMAGE-FILE-URL (UXD-CAT-003).

#### BARCODE-LOOKUP-QUERY — API-CAT-043            traces=API-CAT-043,REQ-CAT-086,REQ-CAT-090,REQ-CAT-097,REQ-CAT-100
Read run on submit of "Find by barcode" (Enter, or the scanner's suffix). A hit navigates to `/cat/items/:itemPk?variant=<variantPk>`. When `embeddedValue` is present, a notice shows "scan-weight" or "scan-price" (by `embeddedValueTypeCode`) with `uomCode`. A miss shows the routed text, the input keeps its value, and focus moves to the text filter ("search by name", RULE-CAT-047's next action).

#### CATALOGUE-SEARCH-QUERY — API-CAT-047            traces=API-CAT-047,REQ-CAT-125,REQ-CAT-126,REQ-CAT-127
Exported by the Items module as the catalogue provider of the shell's global search (ADR-CAT-043, ADR-CAT-051 §2). It is enabled only for terms of at least 2 characters; a shorter term shows RULE-CAT-046's text and sends nothing. Hits keep the server order (exact code or barcode first, at most 20). A hit opens `/cat/items/:itemPk`. A user without PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW gets an empty list from the server (REQ-CAT-127). The provider registers only when the user holds that permission, so the shell shows no catalogue group otherwise.

#### ITEM-SAVE — API-CAT-001 … API-CAT-019            traces=API-CAT-001,API-CAT-003,API-CAT-017,API-CAT-016,API-CAT-020,API-CAT-009,API-CAT-013,API-CAT-010,API-CAT-012,API-CAT-006,API-CAT-008,API-CAT-014,API-CAT-015,API-CAT-018,API-CAT-019,REQ-CAT-004,REQ-CAT-024,REQ-CAT-025,REQ-CAT-049,REQ-CAT-056,REQ-CAT-057,REQ-CAT-077,REQ-CAT-083,REQ-CAT-084,REQ-CAT-105,REQ-CAT-118
Mutation, the screen's ONE Save (ADR-CAT-049). The calls are ORDERED: each is sent only after the previous succeeded, and a part whose lines are unchanged is not sent at all:
1. `API-CAT-001` (new Item; `bundleComponents` = `bundleLines`, or `[]` for STANDARD) or `API-CAT-003` (dirty header; carries `version`).
2. `API-CAT-017`: update of a BUNDLE Item whose `bundleLines` differ from the last read. It carries the Item `version` returned by step 1, or by the last read when step 1 was skipped.
3. Deactivations: barcodes `API-CAT-016` → images `API-CAT-020` → Variants `API-CAT-009` → Item units `API-CAT-013`.
4. Item units: adds `API-CAT-010`, then flag changes `API-CAT-012` (with `version`).
5. Variant generation `API-CAT-006` (when `generation` is set). The success envelope's `CAT-201-EXISTING-VARIANTS-KEPT` shows RULE-CAT-012's text.
6. Variant e-invoice overrides `API-CAT-008` (with each Variant's `version`).
7. Barcodes on saved Variants: `API-CAT-014` (GTIN / SCALE), `API-CAT-015` (internal).
8. Images: uploads `API-CAT-018` (multipart), then changes `API-CAT-019` (with `version`). The success code `CAT-200-PRIMARY-IMAGE-REPLACED` shows RULE-CAT-039's text.

After the last call, or at the first rejection, the Item is re-read and the pending lines that were not sent stay pending. The rejected line is marked `failed` with its routed text, and the "partial-save" copy is shown when any call before it succeeded. A new Item that is rejected after step 1 is replaced by `/cat/items/:itemPk`.

Errors (text = the RULE message in ar/en as the envelope carries it):
- `CAT-422-NAME-AR-INVALID` → inline on header nameAr, or on the image line's nameAr; text: RULE-CAT-001 message (SRS)
- `CAT-422-NAME-EN-TOO-LONG` → inline on nameEn (header or image line); text: RULE-CAT-002 message
- `CAT-409-ITEM-NAME-DUPLICATE` → inline on nameAr; text: RULE-CAT-003 message; action "Open the existing item" → `/cat/items?text=<nameAr>&isActiveFl=true` (one active Item per name)
- `CAT-422-CODE-SYSTEM-ASSIGNED` → form banner; text: RULE-CAT-004 message (the UI never sends a code; seeing it is a defect)
- `CAT-500-CODE-NOT-ISSUED` → form banner with Try again; text: RULE-CAT-005 message
- `CAT-422-LOOKUP-VALUE-INACTIVE` → inline on every lookup field changed in the rejected call, and the lookups are re-read; text: RULE-CAT-006 message
- `CAT-422-BASE-UOM-FIXED` / `CAT-422-ITEM-KIND-FIXED` → form banner; text: RULE-CAT-007 / RULE-CAT-022 message
- `CAT-422-CAPABILITY-OFF` → banner on the flag-bound pane, and the flags are re-read; text: RULE-CAT-008 message
- `CAT-500-CAPABILITY-UNREADABLE` → form banner with Try again; text: RULE-CAT-009 message
- `CAT-409-VARIANT-COMBINATION-DUPLICATE` → on the generation summary row; text: RULE-CAT-013 message
- `CAT-422-VARIANT-LIMIT-EXCEEDED` → on the generation summary row; text: RULE-CAT-014 message
- `CAT-422-BUNDLE-SINGLE-VARIANT` → on the generation summary row; text: RULE-CAT-020 message
- `CAT-409-LAST-ACTIVE-VARIANT` → on the Variant line; text: RULE-CAT-015 message
- `CAT-409-VARIANT-IN-ACTIVE-BUNDLE` → on the Variant line; text: RULE-CAT-021 message
- `CAT-422-BUNDLE-COMPONENTS-REQUIRED` → on the Bundle components pane; text: RULE-CAT-018 message
- `CAT-422-BUNDLE-COMPONENT-INVALID` → on the Bundle components pane; text: RULE-CAT-019 message
- `CAT-422-CATEGORY-INACTIVE` → inline on categoryFk, and the Category options are re-read; text: RULE-CAT-026 message
- `CAT-422-EINVOICE-CODE-INVALID` → inline on einvoiceCode (header, or the override line); text: RULE-CAT-042 message
- `CAT-422-ITEM-UNIT-INVALID` → on the unit line; text: RULE-CAT-027 message
- `CAT-422-CONVERSION-FACTOR-FIXED` → on the unit line; text: RULE-CAT-028 message
- `CAT-409-BARCODE-DUPLICATE` → inline on barcodeValue; text: RULE-CAT-029 message (the server fills {code})
- `CAT-422-GTIN-INVALID` → inline on barcodeValue; text: RULE-CAT-030 message
- `CAT-422-BARCODE-UNIT-INVALID` → inline on the barcode uomCode; text: RULE-CAT-031 message
- `CAT-409-BARCODE-SCALE-PREFIX` → inline on barcodeValue; text: RULE-CAT-032 message
- `CAT-422-SCALE-CODE-LENGTH` → inline on barcodeValue; text: RULE-CAT-033 message
- `CAT-422-IMAGE-NOT-ACCEPTED` → inline on the image file; text: RULE-CAT-038 message · `CAT-413-PAYLOAD-TOO-LARGE` / `CAT-415-UNSUPPORTED-MEDIA-TYPE` → the same place, text: catalogue CAT-413 / CAT-415
- `CAT-422-MEDIA-VARIANT-MISMATCH` → inline on the image variantFk; text: RULE-CAT-040 message
- `CAT-409-STALE-VERSION` → form banner "stale-version" + Reload (pending lines kept); text: catalogue CAT-409-STALE-VERSION
- `CAT-500-CHANGE-NOT-SAVED` → form banner with Try again; text: RULE-CAT-049 message
- `CAT-404-NOT-FOUND` → the line is dropped and the Item re-read; generic text
- unauthenticated → login · forbidden → unauthorized view · server → generic

Invalidation on success: `[cat, items, detail, itemPk]`, `[cat, items, search]`, `[cat, variants, detail]` (this Item's Variants), `[cat, variants, media]`, `[cat, variants, search]`, `[cat, categories, items]`, `[cat, catalogue-search]`.

#### ITEM-STATE-COMMAND — API-CAT-004, API-CAT-005            traces=API-CAT-004,API-CAT-005,REQ-CAT-005,REQ-CAT-006,REQ-CAT-062,REQ-CAT-113,REQ-CAT-114,REQ-CAT-116
Mutation, a record command outside the form, enabled only when the form has no pending change. Deactivate → `API-CAT-004`. Reactivate → `API-CAT-005` `{isActiveFl: true}`. Publish / Unpublish → `API-CAT-005` `{publishStateCode: PUBLISHED | UNPUBLISHED}` — exactly one property per request (ADR-CAT-048).

Errors:
- `CAT-422-PUBLISH-BLOCKED` → command banner; text: RULE-CAT-041 message
- `CAT-409-VARIANT-IN-ACTIVE-BUNDLE` → command banner; text: RULE-CAT-021 message
- `CAT-409-ITEM-NAME-DUPLICATE` (reactivate) → command banner; text: RULE-CAT-003 message
- `CAT-422-LOOKUP-VALUE-INACTIVE` (reactivate) → command banner; text: RULE-CAT-006 message
- `CAT-500-CHANGE-NOT-SAVED` → banner; text: RULE-CAT-049 message
- the success code `CAT-200-DEACTIVATED` → notice; text: RULE-CAT-048 message

Invalidation: `[cat, items, detail, itemPk]`, `[cat, items, search]`, `[cat, categories, items]`, `[cat, catalogue-search]`.

#### ITEM-SCREEN-INIT — SCR-CAT-001
Permission read: PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE, from the platform session. Lookups used: CAT_BRAND, CAT_UOM, CAT_TAX_CLASS, CAT_ITEM_KIND, CAT_PUBLISH_STATE, CAT_EINVOICE_ITEM_CODE_TYPE, CAT_BARCODE_TYPE. Flags: CAPABILITY-FLAGS-INIT. Entity by id when editing: ITEM-QUERY. A new Item starts with `baseUomCode` PIECE, `taxClassCode` STANDARD, `itemKindCode` STANDARD (REQ-CAT-024, AC-CAT-027).

#### ITEM-FACADE — SCR-CAT-001
It composes the queries above. The state it owns:
- the search filters from the URL, including page and size;
- the selected Variant (`?variant=`);
- the react-hook-form instance of `ItemForm`, with the pending lines;
- the open drawer and picker, from the URL;
- derived flags: `isDirty`, `canCommand` (= not dirty), `showVariants` (= `variants` on), `showBundle` (= `bundles` on and kind BUNDLE), `showKind` (= `bundles` on), `scaleOffered`;
- derived loading.

Imperative operations: `save()` (ITEM-SAVE), `deactivate()` / `reactivate()` / `publish()` / `unpublish()` (ITEM-STATE-COMMAND, each after a confirmation), `addLine(kind, value)` / `markDeactivate(kind, id)` (form state only), `applyGeneration(selection)` / `applyComponents(variants)` (from the second levels), `findByBarcode(value)`.
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-CAT-001:END -->

#### CATEGORY-TREE-QUERY / PARENT-OPTIONS-QUERY — API-CAT-039            traces=API-CAT-039,REQ-CAT-067,REQ-CAT-069
The tree view reads with the screen filters. The parent select reads active nodes only, and disables the node being edited and its descendants (computed from the `children` of the tree read — RULE-CAT-023). Depth is computed from the same tree to warn before save.

#### CATEGORY-QUERY — API-CAT-022            traces=API-CAT-022,REQ-CAT-066,REQ-CAT-067
Entity by id for the entry drawer (`?node=<categoryPk>`): it supplies the `version` and fresh values. A deactivated Category stays readable (REQ-CAT-066).

#### CATEGORY-ITEMS-QUERY — API-CAT-040            traces=API-CAT-040,REQ-CAT-068
Feeds the "Items of this category" summary row (total count + 3 names from page 0) and the second-level list (paged). A row jump seeds `/cat/items/:itemPk`, which identifies one Item.

#### CATEGORY-SAVE — API-CAT-021, API-CAT-023            traces=API-CAT-021,API-CAT-023,REQ-CAT-064,REQ-CAT-065,REQ-CAT-069,REQ-CAT-070
Mutation, the drawer's one Save: create (`API-CAT-021`) or update (`API-CAT-023`, with `version`, without `code`). Errors:
- `CAT-422-NAME-AR-INVALID` → inline on nameAr; text: RULE-CAT-001 message
- `CAT-422-NAME-EN-TOO-LONG` → inline on nameEn; text: RULE-CAT-002 message
- `CAT-422-CATEGORY-PARENT-INVALID` → inline on parentCategoryFk; text: RULE-CAT-023 message
- `CAT-409-CATEGORY-DUPLICATE` → inline on code (create) and nameAr; text: RULE-CAT-024 message
- `CAT-409-STALE-VERSION` → drawer banner + Reload; text: catalogue CAT-409-STALE-VERSION
- other → as §3.0

#### CATEGORY-DEACTIVATE — API-CAT-024            traces=API-CAT-024,REQ-CAT-066,REQ-CAT-071
Record command in the drawer, after a confirmation. The success code `CAT-200-DEACTIVATED` → notice, text: RULE-CAT-048 message.

#### CATEGORY-SCREEN-INIT — SCR-CAT-002
Permission read PERM_CAT_CATEGORIES_VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE; no lookups; entity by id: CATEGORY-QUERY. A new node takes `?parent=` as its parent.

#### CATEGORY-FACADE — SCR-CAT-002
It owns: the tree filters (URL); the open node (`?node=`) and `items=open`; the drawer form; the Items-of-category paging inside its filter object; derived loading. Operations: `save()`, `deactivate()`, `openItems()`, `openInItems()` (→ `/cat/items?categoryFk=<categoryPk>`).
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-CAT-002:END -->

#### ATTRIBUTE-LIST-QUERY — API-CAT-041            traces=API-CAT-041,REQ-CAT-048,REQ-CAT-014
The list by sortOrder, each attribute with its values. Enabled only while `variants` is on (UXD-CAT-002); while it is off, the screen shows RULE-CAT-008's text and sends nothing.

#### ATTRIBUTE-QUERY — API-CAT-026            traces=API-CAT-026,REQ-CAT-048
Entity by id for the entry drawer: the attribute's `version` and its values with their `version`s seed the form.

#### ATTRIBUTE-SAVE — API-CAT-025 … API-CAT-031            traces=API-CAT-025,API-CAT-027,API-CAT-029,API-CAT-030,API-CAT-031,REQ-CAT-042,REQ-CAT-043,REQ-CAT-045,REQ-CAT-046,REQ-CAT-047,REQ-CAT-054,REQ-CAT-055
Mutation, the drawer's ONE Save. The calls are ORDERED, and each is sent only after the previous succeeded:
1. `API-CAT-025` (new attribute) or `API-CAT-027` (dirty header, with `version`).
2. Value deactivations `API-CAT-031`. They go first, so that a nameAr freed among the active values can be reused (RULE-CAT-016).
3. Value creates `API-CAT-029` under the attribute's pk returned by step 1, or the existing pk.
4. Value changes `API-CAT-030` (with `version`).

The value calls are not sent at all when the value set is unchanged. At the first rejection the sequence stops: the attribute is re-read, the unsent values stay pending, the failed line is marked, and the "partial-save" copy is shown when an earlier call succeeded.

Errors:
- `CAT-422-NAME-AR-INVALID` → inline on nameAr (attribute or value line); text: RULE-CAT-001 message
- `CAT-422-NAME-EN-TOO-LONG` → inline on nameEn; text: RULE-CAT-002 message
- `CAT-409-ATTRIBUTE-CODE-NAME-DUPLICATE` → inline on code and nameAr of the attribute or value line; text: RULE-CAT-016 message
- `CAT-409-ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-IN-USE` → on the value line; text: RULE-CAT-017 message (the server fills {count})
- `CAT-422-CAPABILITY-OFF` → drawer banner, and the flags are re-read; text: RULE-CAT-008 message
- `CAT-500-CAPABILITY-UNREADABLE` → drawer banner; text: RULE-CAT-009 message
- `CAT-409-STALE-VERSION` → drawer banner + Reload; text: catalogue CAT-409-STALE-VERSION

Invalidation includes the Item reads, because derived Variant names change with the value names (AC-CAT-045, AC-CAT-048).

#### ATTRIBUTE-DEACTIVATE — API-CAT-028            traces=API-CAT-028,REQ-CAT-044,REQ-CAT-054
Record command in the drawer, after a confirmation, only while the drawer has no pending change.

#### ATTRIBUTE-SCREEN-INIT — SCR-CAT-003
Permission read PERM_CAT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES_VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE; the `variants` flag (UXD-CAT-002); no lookups; entity by id: ATTRIBUTE-QUERY. `returnTo` is kept to go back to the Items Entry after Save.

#### ATTRIBUTE-FACADE — SCR-CAT-003
It owns: the list filters (URL); the open attribute (`?attribute=`) and `values=open`; the drawer form with the value lines; derived loading. Operations: `save()`, `deactivate()`, `applyValues(set)` (from the second level, form state only).
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-CAT-003:END -->

#### IMPORT-SHEET-DOWNLOAD — API-CAT-048            traces=API-CAT-048,REQ-CAT-036
Read on click. The binary body is saved as a file named after the import sheet.

#### IMPORT-SUBMIT — API-CAT-049            traces=API-CAT-049,REQ-CAT-037,REQ-CAT-038,REQ-CAT-039,REQ-CAT-040,REQ-CAT-041
Mutation, the screen's one submit (multipart `file`). The response `ImportResult` fills the result view. Errors and notices:
- `CAT-422-IMPORT-FILE-REJECTED` → inline on the file input; text: RULE-CAT-044 message
- `CAT-413-PAYLOAD-TOO-LARGE` / `CAT-415-UNSUPPORTED-MEDIA-TYPE` → inline on the file input; text: catalogue CAT-413 / CAT-415

- `CAT-500-CHANGE-NOT-SAVED` → banner; text: RULE-CAT-049 message

#### IMPORT-SCREEN-INIT — SCR-CAT-004
Permission read PERM_CAT_ITEM_IMPORT_VIEW / CREATE; no lookups; no entity. When mounted by the setup wizard, the wizard's "next" stays the wizard's control; this screen exposes `onImported(result)`.

#### IMPORT-FACADE — SCR-CAT-004
It owns: the chosen file, the import phase, the last result. Operations: `downloadSheet()`, `import()`, `reset()`.

### F2 · SCR-CAT-005 — Barcode labels

```yaml name=screen-hooks
screen: SCR-CAT-005
hooks:
  - {hook: VARIANT-SEARCH-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-042], cache_key: "[cat, variants, search, {text, page, size}]", errors: "CAT-403 → unauthorized · other → generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: SEEDED-VARIANT-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-007], cache_key: "[cat, variants, detail, variantPk]", errors: "CAT-404-NOT-FOUND / CAT-403-FORBIDDEN → seed dropped with a notice (ADR-CAT-051)", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: LABEL-SCREEN-INIT, kind: init, cache_key: "—", errors: "no VIEW → unauthorized", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: LABEL-PRINT, kind: mutation, api: [API-CAT-050], errors: "see LABEL-PRINT below", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: LABEL-FACADE, kind: facade}
```

#### VARIANT-SEARCH-QUERY — API-CAT-042            traces=API-CAT-042,REQ-CAT-101
Feeds the Variant picker: active Variants by code, name or barcode, paged. Each row carries `itemNameAr` and `firstBarcodeValue` (empty when none).

#### SEEDED-VARIANT-QUERY — API-CAT-007            traces=API-CAT-007,REQ-CAT-101
Runs once when the route carries `?variantPk=`. It adds that one Variant as a line, with the earliest-created active barcode from `barcodes[]`.

#### LABEL-PRINT — API-CAT-050            traces=API-CAT-050,REQ-CAT-102,REQ-CAT-103,REQ-CAT-104
Mutation, the screen's one submit. It sends `{lines: [{variantPk, copies}]}`, and the PDF body opens in a new tab. Errors:
- `CAT-422-LABEL-COPIES-OUT-OF-RANGE` → inline on the copies of the offending lines and on the total; text: RULE-CAT-036 message
- `CAT-422-LABEL-VARIANT-NO-BARCODE` → form banner; text: RULE-CAT-037 message (the server fills {count}). Lines whose `barcode` is empty are flagged `no-barcode`, each with "Open item" → `/cat/items/:itemPk` (ADR-CAT-051 §5)
- `CAT-404-NOT-FOUND` → lines no longer found are flagged `not-found`; generic text

#### LABEL-SCREEN-INIT — SCR-CAT-005
Permission read PERM_CAT_BARCODE_LABELS_VIEW / CREATE; no lookups; the seed from `?variantPk=`.

#### LABEL-FACADE — SCR-CAT-005
It owns: the lines (form state), the picker filters (URL, `?picker=variants&text=`), the derived total and the pre-flagged lines without a barcode. Operations: `addVariants(rows)` (duplicates merged, copies 1), `removeLine()`, `print()`.
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-CAT-005:END -->

<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-CAT-006:START traces=REQ-CAT-021,REQ-CAT-022,REQ-CAT-023,REQ-CAT-092,REQ-CAT-093,REQ-CAT-094,REQ-CAT-095,REQ-CAT-098,REQ-CAT-120,REQ-CAT-121,REQ-CAT-122,REQ-CAT-123,REQ-CAT-124,API-CAT-032,API-CAT-033,API-CAT-034,API-CAT-035,API-CAT-036,API-CAT-037,API-CAT-045,API-CAT-051,UXD-CAT-001,SCR-CAT-006 -->
### F2 · SCR-CAT-006 — Catalogue settings

```yaml name=screen-hooks
screen: SCR-CAT-006
hooks:
  - {hook: SETTINGS-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-045], cache_key: "[cat, settings]", errors: "CAT-403 → unauthorized · other → generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: TURN-OFF-CHECK-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-CAT-051], cache_key: "[cat, capability-checks, turn-off, flag]", errors: "CAT-400-REQUEST-INVALID → inline on the flag selector · other → generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: CAT_UOM-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, cache_key: "[mdl, lookup, CAT_UOM]", errors: "select disabled, generic", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, cache_key: "[mdl, lookup, CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT]", errors: "select disabled, generic", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: CAT_SCALE_VALUE_TYPE-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, cache_key: "[mdl, lookup, CAT_SCALE_VALUE_TYPE]", errors: "select disabled, generic", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: SETTINGS-SCREEN-INIT, kind: init, cache_key: "—", errors: "no VIEW → unauthorized", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: LAYOUT-SAVE, kind: mutation, api: [API-CAT-032, API-CAT-033], errors: "see LAYOUT-SAVE below", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "[cat, settings]"}
  - {hook: LAYOUT-DEACTIVATE, kind: mutation, api: [API-CAT-034], errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "[cat, settings]"}
  - {hook: UNIT-CODE-SAVE, kind: mutation, api: [API-CAT-035, API-CAT-036], errors: "see UNIT-CODE-SAVE below", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "[cat, settings] · [cat, variants, detail]"}
  - {hook: UNIT-CODE-DEACTIVATE, kind: mutation, api: [API-CAT-037], errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "[cat, settings] · [cat, variants, detail]"}
  - {hook: SETTINGS-FACADE, kind: facade}
```

#### SETTINGS-QUERY — API-CAT-045            traces=API-CAT-045,REQ-CAT-095
Both lists in full, each entry with its active state. Each drawer edits a list entry (there is no read-by-id operation for these records), taking `version` from the list. A Unit e-invoice code row is labelled by the CAT_UOM lookup of its `key`, and by `valueAr` / `valueEn` when present.

#### TURN-OFF-CHECK-QUERY — API-CAT-051            traces=API-CAT-051,REQ-CAT-021,REQ-CAT-022,REQ-CAT-023
Read run on "Check" with `flag`. Allowed → "allowed-yes" copy. Not allowed → the envelope's success code `CAT-200-VARIANTS-IN-USE` / `CAT-200-BUNDLES-IN-USE` with RULE-CAT-010 / RULE-CAT-011 message (the server fills {count}), `dependentCount`, and up to 20 `dependentItems` (code, nameAr). Each one links to `/cat/items/:itemPk`.

#### LAYOUT-SAVE — API-CAT-032, API-CAT-033            traces=API-CAT-032,API-CAT-033,REQ-CAT-092,REQ-CAT-093,REQ-CAT-098
Mutation, the layout drawer's one Save. Errors:
- `CAT-422-SCALE-LAYOUT-INVALID` → inline on key, scaleCodeLength and valueDecimals; text: RULE-CAT-034 message
- `CAT-409-BARCODE-SCALE-PREFIX` (create: existing barcodes start with the prefix) → inline on key; text: RULE-CAT-032 message
- `CAT-422-LOOKUP-VALUE-INACTIVE` → inline on embeddedValueTypeCode; text: RULE-CAT-006 message
- `CAT-409-STALE-VERSION` → drawer banner + Reload; text: catalogue CAT-409-STALE-VERSION

#### UNIT-CODE-SAVE — API-CAT-035, API-CAT-036            traces=API-CAT-035,API-CAT-036,REQ-CAT-120,REQ-CAT-121,REQ-CAT-124
Mutation, the unit code drawer's one Save. Errors:
- `CAT-409-UNIT-EINVOICE-DUPLICATE` → inline on key; text: RULE-CAT-043 message, with "Open the existing code" → `?unitCode=<pk>` (the active entry with that key, from SETTINGS-QUERY)
- `CAT-422-LOOKUP-VALUE-INACTIVE` → inline on key or einvoiceUnitCode; text: RULE-CAT-006 message
- `CAT-409-STALE-VERSION` → drawer banner + Reload

#### LAYOUT-DEACTIVATE / UNIT-CODE-DEACTIVATE — API-CAT-034, API-CAT-037            traces=API-CAT-034,API-CAT-037,REQ-CAT-094,REQ-CAT-122
Record commands in their drawers, after a confirmation.

#### SETTINGS-SCREEN-INIT — SCR-CAT-006
Permission read PERM_CAT_SETTINGS_VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE; lookups CAT_UOM, CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT, CAT_SCALE_VALUE_TYPE; entity by id: the list entry. A new layout starts with scaleCodeLength 5, WEIGHT, decimals 3.

#### SETTINGS-FACADE — SCR-CAT-006
It owns: the open drawer (`?layout=` / `?unitCode=`), the chosen check flag (`?check=`), the drawer forms, derived loading. Operations: `saveLayout()`, `deactivateLayout()`, `saveUnitCode()`, `deactivateUnitCode()`, `runCheck(flag)`.
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-CAT-006:END -->
<!-- PHASE:F2:END -->

## F3 — Forms & Validators

Forms use `react-hook-form` with a `zod` resolver per form. A client validator mirrors a RULE only where the client holds every input the rule needs. Its message is that RULE's message (SRS), in ar and en, by reference; the client fills a placeholder only when it knows the value. The server stays authoritative, and its codes are mapped back to the same fields (F2). A limit with no RULE (a maximum length from the document) is enforced by the input's `maxLength`, not by a message. A field the server fixes after first save is rendered read-only, not validated.

### F3 · SCR-CAT-001 — Items

`ItemForm` schema:

| Field | Validator | Message |
|---|---|---|
| nameAr | required · 1–200 characters · contains ≥ 1 Arabic letter (U+0600–U+06FF) · stored as typed, Latin letters, digits and symbols kept (REQ-CAT-028) | RULE-CAT-001 |
| nameEn | ≤ 200 characters | RULE-CAT-002 |
| baseUomCode, taxClassCode, itemKindCode | required (pre-filled; create only for baseUomCode and itemKindCode) · an active option of its lookup | RULE-CAT-006 |
| categoryFk | optional · an active node of CATEGORY-OPTIONS-QUERY | RULE-CAT-026 |
| brandCode, einvoiceCodeTypeCode | optional · an active option | RULE-CAT-006 |
| einvoiceCodeTypeCode + einvoiceCode | both or neither · GS1 → 8–14 digits · EGS → starts with `EG-`, ≤ 100 characters | RULE-CAT-042 |
| descriptionAr, descriptionEn | input `maxLength` 2000 | — |

Line validators (each one-line drawer has its own schema; confirming returns the line to `ItemForm` only when it is valid):

| Line | Validator | Message |
|---|---|---|
| Variant override | einvoiceCodeTypeCode + einvoiceCode pair and format, as on the header | RULE-CAT-042 |
| Item unit (add) | uomCode required, ≠ baseUomCode, not the uomCode of another active or pending unit · conversionFactor > 0 with ≤ 6 decimals | RULE-CAT-027 |
| Barcode GTIN | 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits with a valid GS1 check digit | RULE-CAT-030 |
| Barcode GTIN / internal | does not begin with the key of an active scale label layout (from SCALE-AVAILABILITY-QUERY when readable) | RULE-CAT-032 ({prefix} filled) |
| Barcode SCALE | digits only · length equal to an active layout's scaleCodeLength | RULE-CAT-033 ({length} filled) |
| Barcode unit | the base unit or an active (saved) Item unit | RULE-CAT-031 |
| Bundle components | ≥ 1 line · quantity > 0 with ≤ 3 decimals · each componentVariantFk once | RULE-CAT-018 · RULE-CAT-019 |
| Variant generation | 1–3 attributes, each with ≥ 1 value · active Variants after generation (current active + new combinations, computed from the selection) ≤ 300 | RULE-CAT-014 |
| Image (add) | file JPG, PNG or WEBP · ≤ 5 MB · active + pending images ≤ 20 | RULE-CAT-038 |
| Image nameAr / nameEn | nameAr as the header rule (default the Item's nameAr) · nameEn ≤ 200 | RULE-CAT-001 · RULE-CAT-002 |

Form behaviour:
- New Item: only nameAr is empty; the other three mandatory fields are pre-filled (REQ-CAT-024, REQ-CAT-026). Advanced is collapsed and opens automatically when one of its fields carries an error.
- Read-only after first save: code, baseUomCode, itemKindCode, a saved unit's uomCode and conversionFactor, a saved barcode's value, type and unit (RULE-CAT-004, 007, 022, 028).
- Unsaved changes: leaving the route with pending changes asks "unsaved-leave". Closing a drawer or picker discards only its draft.
- Server-to-field mapping: by the routing of ITEM-SAVE (F2). A code whose field cannot be told from the response marks every field changed in the rejected call.
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-CAT-001:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-CAT-002:START traces=REQ-CAT-064,REQ-CAT-065,REQ-CAT-066,REQ-CAT-067,REQ-CAT-068,REQ-CAT-069,REQ-CAT-070,REQ-CAT-071,REQ-CAT-072,API-CAT-021,API-CAT-022,API-CAT-023,API-CAT-024,API-CAT-039,API-CAT-040,SCR-CAT-002 -->
### F3 · SCR-CAT-002 — Categories

| Field | Validator | Message |
|---|---|---|
| code (create) | required · 1–30 Latin letters, digits or hyphens | field hint "code-format" (below) · server duplicate: RULE-CAT-024 |
| nameAr | required · 1–200 · ≥ 1 Arabic letter | RULE-CAT-001 |
| nameEn | ≤ 200 | RULE-CAT-002 |
| parentCategoryFk | optional · active · not the node itself nor one of its sub-categories · resulting depth ≤ 5 | RULE-CAT-023 |
| sortOrder | integer ≥ 0 (input `min`) · default next under the parent | — |

Copy "code-format": ar «من 1 إلى 30 حرفًا لاتينيًا أو رقمًا أو شرطة.» · en "1 to 30 Latin letters, digits or hyphens." (UX copy restating RULE-CAT-024's format; not a catalogue message).
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-CAT-002:END -->

### F3 · SCR-CAT-003 — Variant attributes

| Field | Validator | Message |
|---|---|---|
| attribute code (create) | required · 1–30 Latin letters, digits or hyphens | RULE-CAT-016 |
| attribute nameAr | required · 1–200 · ≥ 1 Arabic letter | RULE-CAT-001 |
| attribute nameEn | ≤ 200 | RULE-CAT-002 |
| value code (new line) | required · 1–30 Latin letters, digits or hyphens · not repeated among this attribute's lines | RULE-CAT-016 |
| value nameAr | required · 1–200 · ≥ 1 Arabic letter · not repeated among this attribute's active lines | RULE-CAT-001 · RULE-CAT-016 |
| value nameEn | ≤ 200 | RULE-CAT-002 |
| sortOrder (attribute and value) | integer ≥ 0 (input `min`) · default next | — |

The values editor validates its draft set before Confirm returns it. The entry's Save validates the whole form again.

### F3 · SCR-CAT-004 — Item import

| Field | Validator | Message |
|---|---|---|
| file | required · extension `.xlsx` · ≤ 10 MB | RULE-CAT-044 |

The row count (≤ 5,000), the header row and every row rule are checked by the server only (RULE-CAT-044, RULE-CAT-045). The client never parses the sheet.

| Field | Validator | Message |
|---|---|---|
| lines | ≥ 1 line (Print is disabled while empty) | — |
| copies (per line) | integer 1–999 | RULE-CAT-036 |
| total copies | ≤ 5,000 | RULE-CAT-036 |

### F3 · SCR-CAT-006 — Catalogue settings

Layout drawer:

| Field | Validator | Message |
|---|---|---|
| key (create) | two digits, `02` or `20`–`29` · not the key of another active layout (from SETTINGS-QUERY) | RULE-CAT-034 |
| scaleCodeLength | integer 4–6 (default 5) | RULE-CAT-034 |
| embeddedValueTypeCode | required · an active option (default WEIGHT) | RULE-CAT-006 |
| valueDecimals | integer 0–3 (default 3) | RULE-CAT-034 |
| valueAr, valueEn | input `maxLength` 200 | — |

Unit e-invoice code drawer:

| Field | Validator | Message |
|---|---|---|
| key (create) | required · an active CAT_UOM option · no active Unit e-invoice code with that key (from SETTINGS-QUERY) | RULE-CAT-006 · RULE-CAT-043 |
| einvoiceUnitCode | required · an active CAT_EINVOICE_UNIT option | RULE-CAT-006 |

Turn-off check: the flag is required and is one of `variants`, `bundles` (a two-option segmented control, so no message).
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-CAT-006:END -->

## F4 — Screens & Routes

Route module: `/cat/*`, registered in the platform shell under the Catalog menu. Each composite screen is one lazy chunk (`cat-items`, `cat-categories`, `cat-variant-attributes`, `cat-item-import`, `cat-barcode-labels`, `cat-settings`). Every route element is wrapped in the permission guard of its page. Open drawers and second levels are search params of the route, so:
- going back closes them;
- dismissing closes only the topmost one;
- a deep link opens them.

Second levels render as siblings of the first level at the route outlet, never inside its element. They have no scroll region of their own: their list scrolls with the drawer body.

| Route | Screen | Guard | Lazy chunk |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/cat/items` | SCR-CAT-001 Search | PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW | cat-items |
| `/cat/items/new` | SCR-CAT-001 Entry | PERM_CAT_ITEMS_CREATE | cat-items |
| `/cat/items/:itemPk` | SCR-CAT-001 Entry | PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW | cat-items |
| `/cat/categories` | SCR-CAT-002 | PERM_CAT_CATEGORIES_VIEW | cat-categories |
| `/cat/variant-attributes` | SCR-CAT-003 | PERM_CAT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES_VIEW (+ `variants` on, else the RULE-CAT-008 state) | cat-variant-attributes |
| `/cat/item-import` | SCR-CAT-004 | PERM_CAT_ITEM_IMPORT_VIEW | cat-item-import |
| `/cat/barcode-labels` | SCR-CAT-005 | PERM_CAT_BARCODE_LABELS_VIEW | cat-barcode-labels |
| `/cat/settings` | SCR-CAT-006 | PERM_CAT_SETTINGS_VIEW | cat-settings |

### F4 · SCR-CAT-001 — Items

#### ITEMS-SCREEN — SCR-CAT-001            traces=REQ-CAT-001,REQ-CAT-003,REQ-CAT-014,REQ-CAT-015,REQ-CAT-026,UXD-CAT-001,UXD-CAT-002,UXD-CAT-003,API-CAT-001,API-CAT-002,API-CAT-038
- **Guard**: `/cat/items` and `/cat/items/:itemPk` need PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW; `/cat/items/new` needs PERM_CAT_ITEMS_CREATE. A missing permission redirects to the unauthorized view. The names come from the SRS B4 matrix and the backend registry.
- **Facade**: ITEM-FACADE only; pages call no query directly.
- **Cross-module**:
  - every lookup-backed field, filter and column → UXD-CAT-001;
  - the Variants pane, attribute fields, Item kind field and filter, and Bundle components pane → UXD-CAT-002;
  - image thumbnails → UXD-CAT-003.
- **Components**:
  - Search: `ItemsSearchPage` (filter bar bound to the URL, "Find by barcode" field, results table, paging, "New item", "Import").
  - Entry: `ItemEntryPage` (header with badges, Advanced section, panes `VariantsPane`, `UnitsPane`, `BarcodesPane`, `BundleComponentsPane`, `ImagesPane`, command bar, Save bar).
  - Exported: `catalogueSearchProvider` (CATALOGUE-SEARCH-QUERY) for the shell's global search.
- **Composition** (spec line: container page · every child collection inline · two pickers as second levels):
  - the panes are inline sections of the page body, in the body's own scroll;
  - a line is added or edited in `ItemLineDrawer` (`?drawer=unit:new`, `unit:<itemUnitPk>`, `barcode:new&variant=<variantPk>`, `internal-barcode:new&variant=<variantPk>`, `override:<variantPk>`, `image:new`, `image:<itemMediaPk>`) — a one-line drawer whose Confirm returns the line to `ItemForm`;
  - `VariantGenerationPicker` (`?picker=variant-generation`) and `BundleComponentPicker` (`?picker=bundle-components`) are their own components, rendered as siblings of `ItemEntryPage` at the route outlet and opened from the search params, not from a boolean the page holds. Their Confirm writes the selection into `ItemForm`; their Cancel discards the draft;
  - a pending generation shows as a summary row in `VariantsPane` with an "Edit" trigger;
  - no inline control is taller than the fields beside it; the image grid uses fixed-size thumbnails.
- **Saves**: ONE (`ITEM-SAVE`). It owns ordered calls (F2): each is sent only after the previous succeeded, and a part whose lines are unchanged is skipped (ADR-CAT-049). The record commands (Deactivate, Reactivate, Publish, Unpublish) are not saves. They are enabled only while `isDirty` is false.
- **Navigation out**:
  - "Print labels" on a Variant line → `/cat/barcode-labels?variantPk=<variantPk>`;
  - "Open Variant attributes" (picker, no active attribute) → `/cat/variant-attributes?attribute=new&returnTo=<this route>`;
  - "Import" → `/cat/item-import`;
  - RULE-CAT-003's next action → `/cat/items?text=<nameAr>&isActiveFl=true`.
- **States**: the Search empty and no-match copy; Entry not-found (CAT-404-NOT-FOUND) with "Back to search"; a skeleton per pane while loading; a pane-level error with Try again.
<!-- SUB:F4-SCR-CAT-001:END -->

## SEC-FE

Permission names are the backend registry's (`PERM_<PAGE_CODE>_<ACTION>`, derived by the given `sec` module from the six CAT page codes). None is redeclared here. The user's permission set is platform session context (ADR-CAT-050 §Consequences). Rules for every screen:
- **Navigation**: a route without its VIEW permission redirects to the unauthorized view, and its menu entry is hidden.
- **Actions**: an action whose permission is missing is hidden. Fields the user may not change are read-only.
- **Forbidden responses**: a CAT-403-FORBIDDEN response is shown as the localized catalogue message from the envelope. On an auxiliary read it hides the affordance that read feeds (ADR-CAT-051 §4).

| SCR | Guard (no VIEW → unauthorized) | no CREATE → hidden | no UPDATE → read-only / hidden | no DELETE → hidden |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SCR-CAT-001 | PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW | "New item", "Add unit", "Add barcode", "Generate internal barcode", "Generate variants", "Add image" (`API-CAT-001`, 010, 014, 015, 006, 018) | header fields read-only, Save hidden on an existing Item; unit flags, Variant override, image changes, Bundle components, Reactivate / Publish / Unpublish hidden (`API-CAT-003`, 012, 008, 019, 017, 005) | Deactivate on the Item, Variant, unit, barcode and image lines (`API-CAT-004`, 009, 013, 016, 020) |
| SCR-CAT-002 | PERM_CAT_CATEGORIES_VIEW | "New category", "New sub-category" | entry fields read-only, Save hidden | Deactivate |
| SCR-CAT-003 | PERM_CAT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES_VIEW (+ `variants` on) | "New attribute", "Add value" | entry and value fields read-only, Save hidden | Deactivate (attribute, value line) |
| SCR-CAT-004 | PERM_CAT_ITEM_IMPORT_VIEW | "Import" (`API-CAT-049`); "Download import sheet" stays | — (no UPDATE action) | — (no DELETE action) |
| SCR-CAT-005 | PERM_CAT_BARCODE_LABELS_VIEW | "Print" (`API-CAT-050`) | — | — |
| SCR-CAT-006 | PERM_CAT_SETTINGS_VIEW | "New layout", "New unit code" | drawer fields read-only, Save hidden | Deactivate (layout, unit code) |

Further rules:
- **Mixed permissions inside the Items Save**: a call is never queued for an action the user cannot take, because the affordance is hidden. A 403 on a queued call stops the sequence like any rejection (ADR-CAT-049 §4).
- **Capability flags are not permissions**: flag-bound affordances are absent while their flag is off (REQ-CAT-014, REQ-CAT-015). The server still refuses a flag-off call (`CAT-422-CAPABILITY-OFF`, REQ-CAT-016), and that refusal is routed as F2 states.
- **Global search**: `catalogueSearchProvider` registers only for a user holding PERM_CAT_ITEMS_VIEW. The server returns no Item results without it (REQ-CAT-127).
- **Tokens**: the bearer token is attached by the platform HTTP client. CAT code never reads or stores it. A CAT-401-UNAUTHENTICATED response goes to login and returns to the same route afterwards.
<!-- PHASE:SEC-FE:END -->

## ALIGN-FE

The checks run against the plan itself, the API document and the SRS ceiling. The cross-artifact checks are `gov.py analyze`'s. Each row names the check that backs it. The result column is copied by the orchestrator from the analyze report; this author writes no mark of their own.

```
ALIGN — CAT v2
row           backing check       assertion                                                                                       result
SCREENS       orphans             every SCR is referenced by a plan block                                                         (stamped from the analyze report)
COMPOSITION   screen-composition  every SCR names where its secondary detail sits and that it saves once                          (stamped from the analyze report)
CONTAINER     composition-rule    every SCR names its container, and a child collection sits where that container puts it        (stamped from the analyze report)
READS         ux-reads-spec       every read a screen binds is an operation of api-spec-cat.yaml, and the plan names the document its mock server serves   (stamped from the analyze report)
UXD           orphans             every UXD is cited by a plan block — this is where a UX decision closes                         (stamped from the analyze report)
TRACES        traces              every PHASE/SUB carries traces=, every UXD traces to its REQ/AC, every SCR to its REQ/UXD       (stamped from the analyze report)
API           traces              every API this plan cites is an operation of api-spec-cat.yaml — never a line of the backend plan's prose   (stamped from the analyze report)
FOREIGN       xref-surface        every reference to another module's surface resolves in that module's own artifacts             (stamped from the analyze report)
REGISTRY      registry-agree      every UXD and SCR defined here is in the stage registry, and nothing else is                    (stamped from the analyze report)
LANGUAGES     languages           labels and messages in ar + en                                                                  (stamped from the analyze report)
MARKERS       markers             the parser reports no structural or semantic error for this track and plan                      (stamped from the analyze report)
DECISIONS     refs-exist          every ADR this plan cites exists on disk in analysis/decisions/CAT/                             (stamped from the analyze report)
COVERAGE      (the report)        the clauses the analyze report lists as having examined nothing — verbatim, or `none`           (stamped from the analyze report)
```

## Index

| Phase | SUBs |
|---|---|

| F3 — Forms & Validators | F3-SCR-CAT-001 … F3-SCR-CAT-006 |

Registry: `registry-exec-fe-cat.md` (same folder).

## Hand-off

After the `P4` verdict, the toolkit splits this plan and its registry into `/frontend-execution/` of the shared repo, and the result is tagged `cat-v2`. The implementer:
- reads the plan in profile-phase order (F1 → F2 → F3 → F4 → SEC-FE → ALIGN-FE);
- reads `ui-ux-spec-cat.md` for intent;
- reads `api-spec-cat.yaml` for every shape, served by its mock server until the backend is delivered;
- does not invent a route, component, permission or field that no F-block traces. A gap is raised as an ADR in `analysis/decisions/CAT/`.

      type: object
      properties:
        rowNumber: {type: integer, format: int32}
        column: {type: string}
        code: {type: string}
        messageAr: {type: string}
        messageEn: {type: string}
    LocalizedError:
      type: object
      description: LocalizedException → {code, messageAr, messageEn}
      required: [code, messageAr, messageEn]
      properties:
        code: {type: string, pattern: '^CAT-\d{3}(-[A-Z0-9-]+)?$'}
        messageAr: {type: string}
        messageEn: {type: string}

# Backend test plan — Catalog / الكتالوج (CAT) — v2

Module : CAT · Version : v2 · Stage : P4 · Track : backend · Plan : test · Profile : commerce
Lane   : test-gen · questions forbidden · TC stream `TC-CAT-{seq:3}` shared with the frontend test plan (this file: TC-CAT-001 … TC-CAT-124; frontend: TC-CAT-125 … TC-CAT-182)

## Header

### Sources (generated current state)
| Input | File | Version | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| srs | `_state/current-srs.md` | CAT v2 (P1) | derivation source: AC-CAT-001 … 129 (Given / When / Then), RULE-CAT-001 … 049 messages, lookups block |
| registry-srs | `_state/current-registry-srs.md` | CAT v2 (P1) | ID ranges (REQ 127 · AC 129 · RULE 49) |
| registry-db | `_state/current-registry-db.md` | CAT v2 (P2) | XM register `records: []` → no integration TC |
| backend-execution-plan | `_state/current-backend-execution-plan.md` | CAT v2 (P3.1) | API-CAT-001 … 051, Error Catalog codes, split units (Package) |
| frontend-execution-plan | `_state/current-frontend-execution-plan.md` | CAT v2 (P3.2) | cross-check of the track split (ADR-CAT-052 §1) |
| api-spec | `_state/current-api-spec.yaml` (`api-spec-cat.yaml`, OpenAPI 3.1.0, 2.0.0) | CAT v2 (P3.1) | shape of every operation a TC asserts on — read by `x-api-id` |
| dependency-graph | `_state/current-dependency-graph.md` | CAT v2 | CAT is tier 1, no outbound edge |

### Delta
The current state holds no earlier test plan, so every TC is ADDED. The TC stream starts at 001. Nothing is MODIFIED or REMOVED.

### Framework
`profile.stack.testing` is **agnostic**. Each block below is the whole contract: the consumer repo chooses its tool and turns each TC into a test. This plan names no framework, annotation or file layout.

### Open ADRs
- ADR-CAT-052 (this stage) is ACCEPTED and non-breaking. It covers the track split, the package binding, the host-data creation surface, catalogue isolation, fields the API document does not expose, and fault injection.
- The TCs also cite ADR-CAT-041, 044, 045, 047 and 048 (P1/P3.1). None of them is BLOCKED.

### Shared precondition S0 (applies to every TC; each TC adds only what it states)
- The caller is a user of preset role Owner holding every `PERM_CAT_*` permission, with a valid bearer token.
- The capability flags `variants` and `bundles` are on and readable through the given `SettingsApi` (FeatureFlags).
- The CAT bootstrap is present: the 10 lookup keys with their seeded values, the series CAT_ITEM / CAT_VARIANT / CAT_INTERNAL_BARCODE, and the 8 seeded Unit e-invoice codes (D-12).
- The TC runs in a tenant of its own, and no data is shared between TCs (ADR-CAT-052 §4).
- Error bodies are read as `LocalizedException → {code, messageAr, messageEn}`. Success notices are read from `ApiResponse<T>` `code` / `messageAr` / `messageEn` (ADR-CAT-048).
- "Owner" below is that user. Every message is asserted in ar and en, copied from the SRS.

### TC-CAT-001 — Deactivating a published Item unpublishes it and keeps it readable
Derived from : AC-CAT-005  (REQ-CAT-005)
Exercises    : API-CAT-004 DELETE /api/v1/cat/items/{id} · API-CAT-002 GET /api/v1/cat/items/{id}
Rule / code  : RULE-CAT-041 (deactivation sets UNPUBLISHED) · RULE-CAT-048 → CAT-200-DEACTIVATED (success notice)
Package      : SVC-API-CRUD
Scenario     : STATE · data class VALID · language ALL
Preconditions: S0 · an active Item with publishStateCode PUBLISHED (created through API-CAT-001, published through API-CAT-005); none of its Variants is a component of an active Bundle
Host data    : none
Steps        : 1. DELETE the Item by itemPk. 2. GET the Item by itemPk.
Expected     : 1 → 200, `code` CAT-200-DEACTIVATED with messageAr «تم الإيقاف. يبقى السجل متاحًا للمستندات السابقة ولا يظهر في الاختيارات الجديدة.» and messageEn "Deactivated. The record stays available to earlier documents and no longer appears in new selections."; data.isActiveFl false, data.publishStateCode UNPUBLISHED. 2 → 200, the Item is returned with isActiveFl false and publishStateCode UNPUBLISHED.
Test data    : the Item of the precondition (any valid nameAr)
<!-- TC:TC-CAT-001:END -->

<!-- TC:TC-CAT-002:START traces=AC-CAT-006,REQ-CAT-006,API-CAT-005 -->
### TC-CAT-002 — Reactivating an inactive Item keeps it unpublished
Derived from : AC-CAT-006  (REQ-CAT-006)
Exercises    : API-CAT-005 PATCH /api/v1/cat/items/{id}
Rule / code  : RULE-CAT-041 (reactivation stays UNPUBLISHED — A7 lifecycle) · —
Package      : SVC-API-CRUD
Scenario     : STATE · data class VALID · language ALL
Preconditions: S0 · an inactive Item (deactivated through API-CAT-004), with no other active Item carrying its nameAr
Host data    : none
Steps        : 1. PATCH the Item with body {isActiveFl: true}.
Expected     : 200; data.isActiveFl true and data.publishStateCode UNPUBLISHED.
Test data    : the Item of the precondition
<!-- TC:TC-CAT-002:END -->

<!-- TC:TC-CAT-003:START traces=AC-CAT-007,REQ-CAT-007,API-CAT-001 -->
### TC-CAT-003 — Second Item with the same Arabic name is refused
Derived from : AC-CAT-007  (REQ-CAT-007)
Exercises    : API-CAT-001 POST /api/v1/cat/items
Rule / code  : RULE-CAT-003 → CAT-409-ITEM-NAME-DUPLICATE
Package      : SVC-API-CRUD
Scenario     : VIOLATION · data class INVALID · language ALL
Preconditions: S0 · an active Item named «شاحن سامسونج 25W» (its code recorded)
Host data    : none
Steps        : 1. POST an Item with nameAr «شاحن سامسونج 25W». 2. GET /api/v1/cat/items?text=شاحن سامسونج 25W&isActiveFl=true.
Expected     : 1 → 409, code CAT-409-ITEM-NAME-DUPLICATE, messageAr «يوجد صنف نشط بالاسم نفسه. افتح الصنف الموجود أو غيّر الاسم.», messageEn "An active item already has this name. Open the existing item or change the name."; the existing Item's code is the next action (envelope field not bound by api-spec-cat.yaml — ADR-CAT-052 §5). 2 → totalElements 1: no Item was created.
Test data    : nameAr «شاحن سامسونج 25W» (from the AC)
<!-- TC:TC-CAT-003:END -->

<!-- TC:TC-CAT-004:START traces=AC-CAT-009,REQ-CAT-009,API-CAT-003 -->
### TC-CAT-004 — A rolled-back Item update publishes no catalogue-change event
Derived from : AC-CAT-009  (REQ-CAT-009)
Exercises    : API-CAT-003 PUT /api/v1/cat/items/{id}
Rule / code  : RULE-CAT-049 → CAT-500-CHANGE-NOT-SAVED
Package      : CORE
Scenario     : VIOLATION · data class EDGE · language ALL
Preconditions: S0 · an active Item; the commit of the next catalogue change is made to fail at the persistence / given outbox seam (ADR-CAT-052 §6); the outbox is observed
Host data    : none
Steps        : 1. PUT the Item with a changed nameEn and its current version. 2. Count the CatalogueChanged events delivered for its itemPk after step 1.
Expected     : 1 → 500, code CAT-500-CHANGE-NOT-SAVED, messageAr «تعذّر حفظ التغيير ولم يُرسل أي إشعار بالتغيير. أعد المحاولة.», messageEn "The change was not saved and no change notice was sent. Try again.". 2 → 0 events; a GET of the Item returns the former nameEn.
Test data    : any nameEn ≤ 200 characters
<!-- TC:TC-CAT-004:END -->

<!-- TC:TC-CAT-005:START traces=AC-CAT-013,REQ-CAT-013,API-CAT-001 -->
### TC-CAT-005 — Unreadable bundles flag refuses a BUNDLE save
Derived from : AC-CAT-013  (REQ-CAT-013)
Exercises    : API-CAT-001 POST /api/v1/cat/items
Rule / code  : RULE-CAT-009 → CAT-500-CAPABILITY-UNREADABLE
Package      : CORE
Scenario     : VIOLATION · data class EDGE · language ALL
Preconditions: S0, except that the given settings service (SettingsApi) returns no value for the `bundles` flag (ADR-CAT-052 §6) · an active STANDARD Item with an active Variant V
Host data    : none

## PHASE INT-XM — not present

CAT has no `XM-*` edge. The registry-db XM register is `records: []`, SRS A8 has `consumes: []`, and the backend plan's last phase `INT-C` carries no block. The integration phase is therefore absent from this plan, not written as an empty block. Inbound use of CAT by other modules (INV, PRC, PUR, SLS, SFR, TAX, INS — dependency graph) is those modules' own edges, and they test them.
